BeforeSideTurnEnd.rationale: `if (!participants.Contains(Owner.Creature)) return; if (Pile.Type != PileType.Hand) return; CardsInHand = Pile.Cards.Count;` (Regret.cs:41-53) == `if self.combat is not None and self in self.combat.player.hand: self._cards_in_hand = len(self.combat.player.hand)`. Both clauses map: the participants test is the side/ownership gate, and the in-hand test is the same `self in hand`. THE SNAPSHOT IS THE POINT -- Regret must count the hand BEFORE the end-of-turn hand processing starts removing cards, and it must count ITSELF, which both sides do because Regret is still in the hand at that moment. The sim's comment states exactly this.
